vocabulario.traduccion: esa misma mañana / más temprano ese día

banco_oraciones.oracion: When Sofía arrived at the station, the train had already left.
Kenji realized that he had forgotten his keys at the studio.
By the time we woke up, Ben had prepared breakfast.
She had locked the door before she went out.
She hadn't locked the studio door that morning.
They hadn't finished the assignment by midnight.
I hadn't seen the northern lights before my trip to Norway.
Ben hadn't turned off the oven before leaving.
Had you ever seen the northern lights before you visited Norway?
Had the train already left when you arrived?
Why had he hidden the old map under the floor?
Had she locked the door before going to bed?
Had they finished by midnight? Yes, they had.
Had you met him before? No, I hadn't.
Had she locked the door? Yes, she had.

interaccion: Sofía: When I arrived at the platform, the train **had already left**!
Ben: Did you run? Or had you fallen asleep at the cafe?
Kenji: I realized that she **had forgotten** to check the schedule earlier that morning.
Abuela Carmen: In my day, if you **had missed** the train, you simply walked under the stars!

banner_diagnostico.opcion_a: When I arrived, the film already started.
banner_diagnostico.opcion_b: When I arrived, the film had already started.

inicio.definicion_pragmatica: The Past Perfect shows the 'past of the past' — the earlier of two completed actions in the timeline.

tabla.titulo: Timeline Detective: Which event happened first?
filas: when Sofía arrived at the station
before he locked the front door
until Kenji showed it to her

ejercicios.pregunta: When Sofía arrived at the station, the train ___
Kenji realized that he ___ his keys at home.
By the time the guests arrived, Abuela Carmen ___ dinner.
She couldn't buy the ticket because she ___ her wallet.
Had you visited London before last summer? ___

ejercicios.afirmacion: The Past Perfect is formed with 'had' + the past participle (3rd column of irregular verbs).
In a narrative, the Past Perfect is used for the action that happened later.

ejercicios.texto: She ___ (not / lock) the studio door before leaving.
When we woke up, Ben ___ (already / prepare) breakfast.
They ___ (never / see) the northern lights before that trip.

ejercicios.respuesta: The train had already left when we arrived
Had you ever seen the northern lights before

ejercicios.texto_con_error: When I arrived, the film already started.
ejercicios.respuesta: When I arrived, the film had already started.

ejercicios.texto_con_error: She had forgot her keys at the cafe.
ejercicios.respuesta: She had forgotten her keys at the cafe.

ejercicios.oracion_base: Sofía arrived. Before that, the train left.
ejercicios.instruccion: Join the sentences using 'when' and Past Perfect.
ejercicios.respuesta: When Sofía arrived, the train had left.

ejercicios.oracion_base: She finished her tea. Then she walked out into the snow.
ejercicios.respuesta: She had finished her tea before she walked out into the snow.

ejercicios.oracion_base: They had finished the report by midnight.
ejercicios.respuesta: They hadn't finished the report by midnight.

ejercicios.pregunta: Had you finished the task before 5 PM? (Short answer: Yes)
Had they locked the front door before leaving? (Short answer: No)

guion: Sofía: Kenji, why did you arrive so late to the rehearsal?
Kenji: By the time my bus arrived, the road **had flooded** completely.
Ben: But had you checked the weather forecast before leaving?
Kenji: No, I hadn't. I **had assumed** it was going to be a sunny day.
Abuela Carmen: Next time, listen to the wind! I **had noticed** the storm clouds before sunrise.

comprension.pregunta: Why was Kenji late to the rehearsal?
What had Abuela Carmen noticed before sunrise?

reading.texto: The old clock tower in the village square had stood silently for fifty years. But when the travelers reached the peak of the mountain at midnight, they noticed something extraordinary: the bells had begun to ring. Local legends claimed that ancient guardians had hidden a secret parchment inside the mechanical gears. Sofia and Ben ran towards the tower doors, only to discover that someone had already opened the bronze lock. The adventure had officially begun.

preguntas.afirmacion: The clock tower had been silent for fifty years before that night.
The bells started ringing before the travelers reached the mountain peak.
Someone had already unlocked the bronze door before Sofia and Ben arrived.
The guardians had hidden a map under the village bridge.
